# Block-world comparison cover redesign

**Creator-reported model · Source-only; not independently reproduced**

One source-provided three-panel game screenshot is the input for two cover redesigns with Chinese headline text. Model names printed inside the cover belong to the depicted comparison, not the image-generation attribution. The input is a single WEBP reference, not a third GPT Image 2.6 output. The source reports xhigh quality, high complexity and first-returned outputs. Those settings and the model identity were not independently reproduced. The original request is public at the linked section; this record supplies only an independent short description and does not reproduce the full prompt. Source timing, cost and quality rankings are not adopted as verified benchmarks.
